notes.closed_enums: a value outside the enums makes the view invalid; refuse it, do not evaluate it
notes.bounded_view: assertions and evidence must be about proposition_id (or proposition_id:<suffix>); conflict rows must name it; otherwise refuse the view
notes.typed_fields: subjects are lists of non-empty strings; freshness_policy_seconds is a non-negative int (0 is valid, bool is not); degraded is a bool; retrieval_scope is a string; missing fields take defaults, present falsy values are kept
notes.unbound_check_conflict: a check whose subjects do not bind still counts toward implied conflict
notes.assertion_polarity: known limit: assertions have no polarity and always count as grounds for TENTATIVE
notes.inconclusive_cap: result=inconclusive cannot raise HUMAN or EXTERNAL
notes.endogenous_cap: endogenous origin cannot raise HUMAN or EXTERNAL, including human methods
notes.implied_conflict: supports+opposes in evidence or checks opens conflict even without a Conflict row
notes.freshness_basis: stale is computed from checks that confer the chosen verification class
notes.trusted_origin_allowlist: Only trusted origins may raise HUMAN or EXTERNAL
notes.degraded_blocks_accepted: sufficiency must be SUFFICIENT for ACCEPTED
notes.subject_binding: subjects[] compared as exact ids: a check may raise HUMAN or EXTERNAL only if neither check nor view declares subjects, or they share one. No family inference; scope text is never scraped
notes.supersession_scope: only superseded_by edges whose from_id is the proposition_id or a variant proposition_id:<suffix> supersede it
notes.not_available_at_t: a record observed after evaluated_at, or with a missing or unparsable instant, is not available at T
